input: literal unencoded double quotes and HTML in the URL passed directly to transformIndexHtml
observation: The raw API is not an HTML sanitizer. The initial broad expectation failed. Browser request URLs percent-encode these characters. Regression cases now use those actual browser encodings plus the exact upstream protocol-relative/query traversal shape, with a real existing fixture package.json.
mitigationScope: The desktop uses the built-in SPA handler, not custom transformIndexHtml middleware. No application handler or expectation was weakened. Raw arbitrary HTML-as-URL sanitation is not claimed.
